# ArkLink: Global Extremes

> An offline, story-led climate thriller visual novel about catastrophe claims, evidence, medical access and branching decisions. / 离线气候悬疑互动小说，以巨灾理赔、证据与分支选择为核心。

The public download is the iPhone/iPad App Store app. English and Simplified Chinese are supported. No game account is required. Saves are local; cloud sync is not promised. Check the regional store for current price.

Release status: the T-402 operating window, override permits, persistent profile abilities, evidence cross-checks and terminal sound effects described on the Gameplay page are upcoming features in development, not a claim about the current App Store build. This is a fictional game, not an insurance service or professional advice.
